Name: Goth Haley Seasonal - Revised
Author: JefGrizli
Description:
A revised version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9861]Goth Haley - Seasonal[/url], now covers all festivals. This mod won't work unless you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url].
All original designs were made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/stanloona420/]stanloona420[/url] (seasonals) or [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/]Poltergeister[/url] (festivals). All changes to these designs are my revisions.


[u][size=4]To Use With Seasonal Outfits[/size][/u]
[size=3]This is now a CP mod![/size]

[list]
[*]You may drop the unzipped folder into your mods directory, it will work just like that.[/*]
[*]Or you may replace Seasonal Outfits' files with these. Simply copy the entire assets folder into Seasonal Outfits' folder; [color=#9fc5e8]folder structure is identical to 6.1.0[/color]. You will be asked to replace files! However, you will have to do so everytime Seasonal Outfits updates. [i]Piercings[/i] option does [b][color=#ea9999]NOT[/color][/b] work this way.[/*]
[/list]
If the first option doesn't work for you, use the second one.


[u][size=4]Goth Haley's Rooms[/size][/u]
A redesign of Haley's rooms to better reflect her goth style.
Recolour and SVE compatible.



[u][size=4]Config Option[/size][/u]
[color=#f6b26b]NoNose[/color]: true, false; default: true
Affects all NoNose actions independent from the setting in SCC.
[color=#f6b26b]NoPiercings[/color]: true, false; default: false
Option to disable Haley's lip piercings.

[color=#f6b26b]Spouse Room[/color]: true, false; default: true
Option to disable changes to Haley's spouse room.



[u][size=4]Easter Egg[/size][/u]
[color=#666666]Spouse Portrait features Mari's original design (^-^)[/color]
